facts.fact: BusinessDay states that NITDA's National Cloud Computing Policy was first issued in 2019 and established a Cloud First approach for government institutions.

BusinessDay states that NITDA's National Cloud Technical Document proposes standards for sovereign cloud deployments for public institutions, including procurement, deployment models, data classification and hosting of higher-sensitivity government data within Nigeria; no date is given, so the published date 2026-08-13 is used.
